snippet.title: 1 Billion Spells - Teaser
snippet.description:
1000000000 Spells is an Arena Survival game where you fight off hordes of enemies by making your own spells on the go, using a complex and intricate programming-adjacent system. No more leveling up fireball from level 7 to level 8! Magic should be expressive, free, intense and chaotic.

Play as one of the new students of a modern magic academy and master their diverse magic styles. Unlock new arenas, components, and students and create the most creative, weird and overpowered spells ever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390410/1B_Spells/

Music:
Alchemists Tower Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
